summary: Practise GHS hazard review, SDS checks, chemical inventory and spill planning in a five-day intermediate course. Explore the outline.
lede: Chemical safety training helps handlers and supervisors identify substance hazards and control risks during storage, use and incident response. Participants practise reviewing safety data sheets, building chemical inventories, assessing exposure routes, checking storage compatibility and selecting controls. Exercises also cover planning spill responses and recording corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits people who handle hazardous substances or oversee the records, controls and response arrangements that keep chemical work safe.
modules: Hierarchy of Controls for Chemical Tasks
prerequisites: Working familiarity with workplace chemical handling or occupational safety responsibilities is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
